system.description:
• Effect: Advantage on the attack roll plus a scaling damage die (see the Assassin Progression Table) against an aware-but-unsuspecting target. Usable once per round. A target is unsuspecting if it cannot see you, has not yet acted this encounter, or is in melee with one of your allies and not with you.
  • Usable at range within 30ft
  • No prior stealth check required
  • A Death Attack is delivered by a Sneak Attack; if the target saves, it takes maximum Sneak Attack dice damage

activities.name: Sneak Attack
activities.text: Gain Advantage and add the Sneak Attack die against an unsuspecting target within 30ft; see the Assassin Progression Table for the dice.

rules.when: Sneak Attack vs an unsuspecting target (cannot see you, has not acted yet, or in melee with an ally and not you)

rules.value: Sneak Attack: add the Sneak Attack dice from the Assassin Progression Table (once per round).
